    Cancellation in Grothendieck monoids of torsion and torsion-free classes #

    Corollary 4.3 (cor:monoid-cancellation) of the manuscript:

    • isEFinite_iff_torsionMonoids_cancellative: since the group completion K₀(T) embeds into K₀(mod R) (Proposition 4.2), the dimension-vector map M(T) → K₀(mod R) is injective if and only if M(T) is cancellative; hence R is E-finite if and only if every torsion class has a cancellative Grothendieck monoid.
    • isEFinite_iff_torsionFreeMonoids_cancellative: contravariant k-duality exchanges torsion classes of mod Rᵐᵒᵖ with torsion-free classes of mod R and preserves Grothendieck monoids (GrothendieckMonoid.mapAnti), giving the same criterion for torsion-free classes.
